sourceHeader.keywords: Hijutsu, Ninjutsu, Bukijutsu, Water Release, Bio Serpent

system.description:
Emulating the ability of your Bio-Pet to constrict a foe, you aim to have your armor do that for you. You melt some linking pieces of the armor you are wearing, creating a black liquid you can freely manipulate, that dart out and attempt to trap your foe. The target must make a Strength saving throw. On a failure, their mobility is greatly hindered, as their speed is reduced by 20 feet. If a creatures speed is reduced below half the maximum, the liquid metal is able to seep into open parts of their body poisoning them, as they enter a Stupor until the end of your next turn.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and the number of creatures you can target by +1. If this jutsu is cast at C-Rank or higher, creatures that fail their saving throw have the liquid metal begin to harm their armor as it liquifies some of their armor temporarily, reducing their AC and DR by 2, until the end of your next turn. This penalty increases by 1 for every rank above C-Rank this jutsu is cast.
